# Quality-Assured Vietnamese SMS Phishing Dataset (Sample Evaluation Corpus)

This repository provides an open-access 300-message evaluation sample of the **Quality-Assured Vietnamese SMS Phishing Dataset**, a leakage-controlled benchmark constructed using a closed-loop multi-annotator agreement framework and near-duplicate template deduplication (J ≥ 0.85).

## Authors & Research Team

- **Trần Nguyễn Thái Tuấn** (Lead Researcher & Project Lead)
- **Lê Hoàng Khang** (Researcher)
- **Nguyễn Minh Tài** (Researcher)
- **Nguyễn Văn Thắng** (Researcher)
- **Mai Hoàng Đỉnh** (Project Advisor / Mentor)

## Dataset Summary

- **Language:** Vietnamese (`vi`)
- **Task:** Binary SMS Spam / Phishing Detection (`HAM` vs. `SPAM`)
- **Sanitization:** 100% PII Anonymized (Phone numbers, bank accounts, names, and OTP tokens replaced with standardized tokens `[PHONE]`, `[BANK_ACC]`, `[MONEY]`, `[NUMBER]`, `[TIME]`)
- **Quality Audit:** Manually audited on 200 random samples showing **0% residual PII leakage**.
- **Licensing:** Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International ([CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/))

## Dataset Structure

The dataset file `sample_300.csv` contains the following columns:

| Column Name | Data Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `message_id` | String | Unique tracking identifier (e.g., `COM_001`, `COM_002`) |
| `text` | String | Sanitized unaccented/accented Vietnamese SMS text |

## Ethics Statement & Institutional Review
Collection protocol was granted formal institutional ethics exemption (IRB Protocol Ref: `IRB-2026-NLP-0428`). All user-contributed messages were gathered under voluntary informed consent.
